name: Anett Hosenfeld
original_name: アネット・ホーゼンフェルト
source: Anett is a member of the 666th TSF Squadron and one of the few melee halberd users in the NVA, giving her a reputation as an abnormal pilot wherever she fights. She has a habit of screaming to shake off the fear of death before battle and suffers from PTSD.
